claims: This manifest defines objectives only. It contains no completion evidence and authorizes no save automation.

workflow.approval: Human approves launch and selects an existing Alucard save through the visible native UI.
workflow.observe: Record sanitized build/mod/session identity and safe Play state; do not claim a cold launch from a reload or reset.

workflow.approval: Human prepares Marble Gallery room 9 and physically plays the declared ordered route.
workflow.observe: Run coop-route-25 where required and retain transition counters, frames, room sequence, cleanup, and private artifact ID.

workflow.approval: Human curates ordinary supported enemies and explicitly performs contact, projectile, drop attempts, downing, and revive.
workflow.observe: Retain p2d4/2 metric deltas; a native no-drop attempt is not associated-drop completion.

workflow.approval: Human saves through the native menu with coop-feasibility enabled and confirms the visible slot.
workflow.observe: Record only visible slot label/time and sanitized runtime identity; never copy, hash, parse, or write save bytes.

workflow.approval: Human fully exits, disables the mod before restart, and approves loading that visible native save.
workflow.observe: Record successful ordinary Play and visible progression checks without direct save access.

workflow.approval: Human starts coop-soak-60m and actively plays the declared route and ordinary combat for the full hour.
workflow.observe: Retain 13 scheduled samples and private screenshots at minutes 0, 30, and 60. Idle observation is stability evidence only.

prohibitions: No direct save loading, save writes, save parsing, save copying, or save hashes.
No filesystem paths, disc paths, credentials, tokens, desktop captures, or raw logs in success evidence.
No launch, stop, reset, reload, mod mutation, file selection, or gameplay input by observer campaigns.
Do not claim cold-launch, save-integrity, route, combat, drop, revive, or playable-soak completion until humans perform it live.
